name: Default captions
use: The everyday words on screen while you talk: how each 2-3 word chunk arrives.

name: Accent text
use: A line that pops in your accent colour: how its words arrive.
options: Clean rise, snappy: the words land fast

name: Headline: white on top, accent underneath
use: A stacked headline with no box: white line(s) on top, a bigger line in your accent colour underneath.
options: Two lines, accent line bigger, blur rise
Three lines, big middle, accent last line
Two lines, clean rise instead of blur
Three lines, big middle, clean rise

name: Text behind your head
use: Big words that sit behind your head, so you look like you're standing in front of the title.
options: White on top, accent underneath, behind your head
Hook: title behind your head with your real app icon
One huge white word behind your head

name: Intro text
use: The opening hook: a small lead-in, one huge hero word, a last line gliding in.
options: Hero word shine, last line glides in from the right
Hero word focus-in, in your caption colour

name: Text fades
use: A title that is solid at the top of each line and melts away at the bottom.
options: Deep colour melting into your paper
Your accent melting into its soft tint
Ink melting early (the fade starts 30% down)
Ink melting late (the fade starts 70% down)

name: CTA
use: The call to action: the comment keyword over your face.

name: Zooms on your face
use: How the camera moves in on you between cuts.
options: Gentle: starts at 110%, glides out over 2.2 s
Dramatic: starts at 135%, glides out over 5 s

name: Diagrams
use: Full-screen drawings that explain an idea, building up line by line.
options: Tree with your videos, fade in
Tree with your videos, clean rise
Tree with your videos, blur rise, on white
Mind map, clean rise, on your colour
Tree with your videos, slow glide, on your soft tint
Tree with your videos, rounded thumbnails

name: Split-screen diagrams
use: A diagram on the top half of the screen with you underneath.
options: Fan out and merge, on your colour
Plugged into your apps, on white
Fan out and merge, on white
Plugged into your apps, on your colour

name: Clean explainers
use: Short full-screen explainer scenes for one idea, ending in a split with you.
options: Concept card, three layers light up, cut to a split
Your first app looks around, then a winding road to the goal
Tool intro: your real app icon, its name, then what it does

name: Logos
use: How the real app logos you mention land on screen.
options: Tilted and overlapping, slow glide in
Row of four icons rising one by one

name: Real images
use: Real photos on screen while you talk, appearing with hard cuts.
options: Photos flash above your head, hard cuts
Hook: real logos and a real photo over the title

name: Split screen
use: A real page from the internet on top, you underneath: scroll, push in or ring the detail.
options: Fast push-in to the key detail
Card on white, ring on the key detail
Card on your colour, ring on the key detail
Gentler push-in (1.6x) to the key detail

name: Tool talk
use: Talking about a tool: its site on top, you below, captions in a box on the seam.
options: Frosted glass box in your colour

name: Switching modes
use: How the edit jumps between you, a split screen and a full-screen diagram.
options: Hard cuts, one slide into full screen

name: Caption placement
use: Where the captions sit on your face.

name: White text drop shadows
use: The shadow that keeps white captions readable over bright, busy pages.
